coverage_definition: This article prepares spiroketal fragment A (28), original and revised central fragments B/B-prime and structure-validation derivatives. Target-level assembly and southern fragment C are in an accompanying article, not supplied here. All generated structures are candidates pending independent source review. Available SI preparations covered, with explicitly unidentified minor isomers/deprotected byproducts and omitted analogue procedures retained as unresolved boundaries. Provisional mechanistic drawings20/59 are labelled distinctly from isolated compounds.

issues.detail: Full benthol A assembly and fragment C belong to the accompanying paper; never infer those operations from retrosynthetic schemes.
issues.subject: target1

issues.detail: SI25-27 uses the S10 heading across a characterized PMB-protected intermediate and final primary alcohol; these are retained as S10-PMB and S10, respectively.
issues.subject: S10

issues.detail: SI67 says methyl ester52 but mass20mg/40.8umol matches53; SI69 says64 though main Scheme13 explicitly includes MOM cleavage before reduction/deprotection. Network follows drawn MOM-cleaved53/S21; no silent replacement of the conflicting prose.
SI72 prints ester S22 259.0 g /0.36mmol; incompatible scale is retained as a source typo, not an extraction quantity.
94% is combined E/Z=2.7:1 product over two steps, never assigned individually.
issues.subject: 38-E/38-Z

issues.detail: THP analogues12/19 lack detailed preparation procedures in available SI;20 is mechanistic proposal, not isolated.
SI46 reports an11% partially TBS-deprotected by-product without identifying which TBS group; no invented unique structure is assigned.
SI33 reports10% combined three minor diastereomers without unique structures/configuration, retained only as unresolved mixture.
issues.subject: 34/S12

issues.detail: Source-bound facts require independent chemist review.

report_heading: Total Synthesis of Benthol A: Evidence for a Structure Revision. — source-bound synthesis network
report_note: This article prepares spiroketal fragment A (28), original and revised central fragments B/B-prime and structure-validation derivatives. Target-level assembly and southern fragment C are in an accompanying article, not supplied here. All generated structures are candidates pending independent source review. Available SI preparations covered, with explicitly unidentified minor isomers/deprotected byproducts and omitted analogue procedures retained as unresolved boundaries. Provisional mechanistic drawings20/59 are labelled distinctly from isolated compounds. Facts compiled deterministically; independent review pending.
